name: Organic Farm
shortDescription: Come and live a unique experience with us in Thallasses Villas biological garden.Plant with us and taste fresh biological vegetables in your daily breakfast, also every night you will have in your villa a basket of fresh and organic vegetables which have grown only with water.
longDescription:
Come and live a unique experience with us in Thallasses Villas biological garden.Plant with us and taste fresh biological vegetables in your daily breakfast, also every night you will have in your villa a basket of fresh and organic vegetables which have grown only with water.

Check out our planting process here!
todos: Slug/title mismatch: the URL slug is "biological-garden" but the page TITLE, og:title and H1 are all "Organic Farm". Decide which name to keep before migrating (affects redirects).
META description, og:description and twitter:description are all just the page title ("Organic Farm"); there is no unique SEO description in the source.
Brand name misspelt in the body copy: "Thallasses Villas" (double "l") instead of "Thalasses Villas". Preserved verbatim.
Missing space after the full stop in the body copy: "...biological garden.Plant with us and...". Preserved verbatim.
Gallery captions read "Thalasses Villas - Oganic Farm" — "Oganic" is a typo for "Organic". It is repeated on 7 of the 8 gallery images. Preserved verbatim.
One gallery image (CMS alt text "Album Image #17615", URL .../50f5ab5b8a6a26a89221cde41c32a205_thumb.jpg) has NO caption in the source while all other gallery images do.
The copy mixes "biological" and "organic" for the same thing ("fresh biological vegetables" vs "fresh and organic vegetables") — terminology should be unified.
The claim "which have grown only with water" is unclear/unsubstantiated — verify what is meant before republishing.
The only link on the page uses the bare anchor text "here" ("Check out our planting process here!"), which is poor link text for accessibility and SEO; it points to a YouTube video.

Gallery image URLs in the source markup are the "_thumb.jpg" variants; only the hero/parallax background is available at full size. Full-resolution URLs for the gallery images are not present in the crawled source.
No highlights, bullets or structured list exist in the source, so highlights is empty.
No duration stated anywhere in the source page; duration left null.
No price, rate or 'from' figure stated anywhere in the source page; price left null.

No page-specific call to action exists in the source. The only CTA on the page is the site-wide booking bar ("Book now" -> https://thalassesvillas.reserve-online.net/), which is global chrome, so cta is null.

Gallery captions are recorded in the new gallery object: 7 of the 8 album images carry data-caption="Thalasses Villas - Oganic Farm" ("Oganic" is a typo for "Organic", preserved verbatim); the 8th (50f5ab5b8a6a26a89221cde41c32a205) has a genuinely empty data-caption, so its caption is null.
categoryProposed is an editorial grouping added for the redesign; the live site has no categories — confirm with the client.
